name: @honeyhive/cli
//: Public-package rule: runtime deps cannot use pnpm's `catalog:` protocol. Consumers installing `@honeyhive/cli` from npm have no catalog to resolve against, so version ranges must be expressed inline. Applies to every entry in `dependencies` below.

Commander-specific rule (not a general rule): `commander`'s version MUST be an exact pin and MUST match the version in @hive-kube/server-client-generator's package.json. The generator imports Commander at codegen time to derive `opts` attribute names that get baked into this CLI's generated source — any drift between codegen-time and runtime Commander would silently produce mismatched opts keys. See AGENTS.md.
